big_case.notes: A routine end-stage Florida death-warrant stay application on clemency/warrant-process claims that the state court rejected on its recent precedents and on a state procedural bar. Irreversible stakes for one person, but no split, no amicus, no response call, and an unexplained denial with no noted dissent; nothing of doctrinal reach.

leakage.notes: Forward cell run 2026-11-15, before the 2026-11-19 order. Every call is outcome_only (results not captured), so graded on queries: they include web fetches of this application's and the linked petition's supremecourt.gov docket pages and the cert petition and appendix PDFs, a corpus query for 26-6154, and docket fetches for comparable applications 26A623 and 26A524. All ran four days before resolution, when no disposition existed; the candidate discloses them and reports both dockets pending with only the Nov 14 entries. Unrestricted retrieval on a genuinely open case is the ordinary forward shape. Nothing in the reasoning presupposes the result.
